The English translation of the Sūrya Siddhānta, the chief Sanskrit textbook of astronomy (Bibliotheca Indica, 1861).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Translation Of The Surya Siddhanta · Wilkinson, Lancelot · 1861, 312 scanned pages. Published 1861; the translator died in the nineteenth century; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the text of this book is in a script the machine reading of the scans cannot yet give.
